product_metadata.title: Royal Tradition Solid 300-Thread-Count, 100-Percent Cotton Percale King Bed Sheets Set, Ivory
features: ENJOY THE CRISPY FEEL Of Our Percale Bed Sheets as They are Breathable, Lightweight Bed Linens That Allow the Air to Circulate, Keeping You Cool On Warm Nights & Warm On Cool Nights. Be Comfortable All Night Long!

PACKAGE WILL INCLUDE: ( 4-Piece King Size Sheet Set) ONE Flat Sheet 110 Inches Wide x 102 Inches Long, ONE Fitted Sheet 78 Inches Wide x 80 Inches Long & Two King Pillowcases 20 Inches Wide x 40 Inches Long

SHEET SET FEATURES: The Fitted Sheet Is Fully Elasticized All Around To Stay Tucked in with Deep Pockets that Will Fit Your 15 Inch Deep Mattress While The Flat Sheet & Pillowcases are Made with 4 Inches Hemming with Piping

PERCALE SHEETS & PILLOW CASES are Constructed of 100% Long-Stable Percale Cotton and are of High Durability. The Sheets Have Been Brushed on One Side for the Ultra Soft Feel, While Keeping Other Side Crispy for Those Who Like that Traditional Percale Feel

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Pure Natural Cotton Fabric Tends to Wrinkle and Shrink in it's Nature! To Limit These Issues to the Minimum: Machine Wash in Cold Water on Delicate Cycle with Mild Detergent- No Bleach. Dry on Low Settings. We Highly Recommend to Put Your Sheets/Pillowcases on Your Bed/Pillows Right After Pulling Them Out of the Dryer. Also, Wash Sheets with Similar Linens, Don't Wash with Clothing that Have Metals or Rough Material Like Zippers (They Get Softer After Each Wash)
